##: Manifest for the own bucket at https://github.com/ruslan-rv-ua/scoop-bucket. This copy is
what the bucket is first seeded from, by hand, at release checklist step F9. After that
the bucket's own copy is bumped by its Excavator, which reads the checkver and autoupdate
fields below — started by hand at F10, with a daily run as a backstop. Nothing bumps this
copy; it is the seed, not the live manifest. See packaging/README.md.
The '#/PathMaster.exe' fragment renames the download, so 'bin' and 'shortcuts' stay
stable across versions while the release asset keeps its version in its name.
A GUI app needs nothing special: scoop patches the shim's PE subsystem to GUI when the
target is GUI, so the PATH shim does not flash a console; 'shortcuts' adds the Start
snapshots and the log survive an update. A junction is compatible with the rule that
the Data Directory is resolved from the executable's own location (spec §3).
autoupdate's hash comes from the release's .sha256 sidecar. '$url' there is the
download URL with the '#/' fragment stripped, so '$url.sha256' is the sidecar beside
the asset — and the sidecar's '<hex64> *<filename>' line is exactly what scoop's
